content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert: streaming endpoint p99 latency > 1.5s in us-west-2. SLO breach. auto-ticket created #INC-3880.

maria: seeing big tail here, p95 ~420ms but p99 is 1.6s+ for streaming-write and chat-stream. Graphs show a sharp jump at 12:03 UTC.

neha: anything from yesterday's prefix-hash rollout? we flipped prefix_hash_v3 at 02:10 and rolled canary up at 10:40.

alex: looking at cache metrics now — prefix_cache_hit_rate dropped from 92% -> 12% in the same window. prefetched keys show miss spike. likely mismatch in prefix salting.

maria: confirmed. rpc logs show repeated cache-miss slowpath followed by paging calls to kv-store causing stalls.

jon: customer-impact? any 5xx?

luis: no 5xx spike but increased aborts on streaming websockets: clients see streaming stalls then reconnects. enterprise customers A and C reported degraded UX.

ops-bot: @oncall jon assigned. Runbook: run prefetch, consider immediate rollback of prefix-hash flag, or route streaming traffic to dedicated pool.

neha: quick triage steps: 1) Check prefix_hash_seed on prod config 2) Check prefix mapping table in kv 3) Compare canary vs prod salt values

alex: grabbing traces.

alex: trace sample — repeated code:
```
fetch_prefix_kv(key) -> miss -> page_to_s3 -> long tail (~1.1s extra)
stack: runtime/prefetcher.go:274
```

maria: metrics queries:
```bash
curl -s 'http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=prefix_cache_miss_rate%7Bregion%3D%22us-west-2%22%7D' | jq .
```
result: 0.88 at peak.

alex: deployed prefix_hash_v3 had new salt algorithm that changed how keys are hashed. our prefix registrar wasn't migrated for some namespaces (edge/streaming). That explains low hit rate.

jon: options: rollback the prefix_hash flag globally (fast), or add compatibility layer to compute both v2 and v3 prefixes at lookup (slower but safer). For immediate mitigation, rollback + rewarm.

neha: rollback plan: patch feature-flag in config map, rolling restart of prefix-service workers in us-west-2. Will cause brief churn.

maria: rewarm plan: run prefetch script over recent popular keys (based on top-k from metrics) and enable short-term TTL extension to avoid immediate evictions.

alex: I'll prepare the rollback PR and small patch to add dual-hash logging to help validate once we flip back.

luis: also suggest temporary routing rule — send streaming traffic with header x-traffic-class: dedicated to dedicated pool where we have warmed caches. That buys time for rewarm.

maria: customer comms: reach out to customers A and C. I can draft note. We should include expected ETA for rollback ~10-15m + rewarm ~30m.

ops-bot: rollback approval required from eng-lead. @maria please confirm.

maria: approving rollback. doing coord with SRE.

alex: rolling prefix-service deploy now (patch + disable prefix_hash_v3 flag)
```bash
kubectl -n prod patch cm prefix-config -p '{"data":{"prefix_hash_version":"v2"}}'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/prefix-service --selector=region=us-west-2
```

jon: oncall takeover: I'll monitor p95/p99 and streaming success rate. handing off to me at 12:15 UTC. @neha you have the lead for postmortem.

neha: noted. I'll collect diffs and config audit. plan to add canary gating for prefix-scheme in the future.

maria: prefetch job started (parallel workers 32)
```bash
python tools/prefetch_topk.py --region us-west-2 --top_k 5000 --parallel 32
```

alex: rollback done, restarting 12 nodes, status 12/12 ready.

maria: seeing improvement: prefix_cache_hit_rate back to ~89% within 90s. p99 dropping to ~420ms. p95 steady ~380ms.

luis: streaming aborts reduced, customers reporting better behavior.

ops-bot: update: incident state -> mitigation in place. Next: warm up remainder, verify no stale mismatch.

neha: root cause hypothesis: missing namespace migration in prefix registrar + insufficient canary gating (we promoted full rollout while registrar inconsistently updated). will include remediation: preflight check to ensure registrar sync, add canary metric threshold (hit_rate delta < 5%) before rollouts.

jon: handoff note for next oncall: keep monitoring p99 < 500ms, check prefix_cache_miss_rate < 0.1 for next 6 hours, and confirm rewarm completed.

maria: drafting customer message and RCA stub. tagging customers A,C for follow-up.

alex: will add telemetry: log both v2 and v3 derived keys for 1h to validate no lingering mismatches.

luis: thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident INC-3880 -> mitigation in place, severity reduced to P2. Postmortem owner: neha.

jon: closing handoff — oncall until 14:00 UTC. ping me for follow-ups.

neha: will open postmortem ticket and schedule timeline.

maria: :thumbsup: good ops.
